title: David B NDE 4908
content: During a car trip with my wife I had to stop because of a severe illness with sudden sweating, precordial, and neck pain. I was taken by ambulance to the hospital and subjected to all appropriate therapies. I felt a progressive loss of consciousness as I was fast sinking down into a vortex. I generally felt alarmed and distressed, but perceived everything with clarity. Then there was nothing, absolute nothingness. I do not know for how long, and suddenly I was conscious at the same time of a strong electricity shock. Then I woke up out of the body, or rather without a body. I was in a not well-defined tunnel. I moved weightlessly through the tunnel, from an initial darkness that gradually grew lighter. I did not see any form of objects or people, but I felt the reassuring presence of beings or incorporeal souls. I could not distinguish them from each other, but I felt as full of love and desire to help and accompany me. I felt they were my deceased relatives or friends who were in close contact with me. They pushed me gently towards one direction. My mood was an indescribable bliss, like heat without temperature but made of love and total satisfaction. Then suddenly it's all over and I found myself in the middle of the team of doctors and nurses.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Strong electricity shock; 'woke up out of the body, or rather without a body.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Reassuring presence of 'beings or incorporeal souls' felt to be deceased relatives or friends, indistinguishable from each other, full of love and desire to help; they gently pushed him in one direction.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe sudden illness during car trip with sweating and precordial/neck pain; taken by ambulance to hospital and treated.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vortex/sinking; absolute nothingness; strong electric shock; bliss 'like heat without temperature but made of love and total satisfaction.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Progressive loss of consciousness with sensation of sinking into a vortex, then 'absolute nothingness', then simultaneous awareness of a strong electric shock and being conscious again, then out-of-body/without a body in a tunnel that gradually grew lighter, accompanied by reassuring incorporeal presences, then abrupt return among doctors and nurses.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He was 'conscious at the same time of a strong electricity shock' before the OBE/tunnel phase.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Report of 'absolute nothingness' phase; strong electric shock coinciding with return of consciousness; initial sensation of sinking into a vortex before nothingness/tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then there was nothing, absolute nothingness.” / “I woke up out of the body, or rather without a body.” / “My mood was an indescribable bliss, like heat without temperature but made of love and total satisfaction.”
